metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: Since they loved Finding Nemo, this sequel offers more ocean adventures and funny characters like the forgetful Dory.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: An action-packed family movie that captures the heroic vibes seen in Spider-Verse and Sonic.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A thrilling adventure about dragons and friendship that matches the epic scale of The Sea Beast and Raya.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A high-tech adventure with a very lovable robot and great superhero themes similar to Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A gentle and beautiful story about friendship and summer that fits perfectly with the Studio Ghibli films on the list.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: Like Inside Out 2, this film explores complex emotions and life in a way that is colorful and accessible for kids.

metas.name: Onward
metas.description: A magical quest featuring two brothers that captures the fantasy elements of Tangled and Howl's Moving Castle.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious take on the 'villain' story that fans of Despicable Me and The Bad Guys will find very funny.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A heartwarming journey across China with a magical yeti, similar in tone to Migration and Moana.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: Full of goofy humor and inventive visuals, it shares the energetic comedy style of Shrek and Sing.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A unique visual style and family-focused comedy that aligns with The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A classic Pixar comedy with great characters and a heartwarming story similar to Toy Story.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A beautiful adventure about an old man and a boy scout that captures the emotional depth of Coco.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A very charming and kind-hearted family comedy about a bear living in London.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Widely considered one of the best family films ever made, continuing the wholesome adventures of the kind bear.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: Funny and fast-paced, this movie about what pets do when humans leave will appeal to fans of Rio and Zootopia.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Since they enjoyed the first two, this concludes Po's main journey with more laughs and great action.

metas.name: Despicable Me 2
metas.description: Expands on the first film with more Minion antics and Gru's transition into being a hero.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: Pure slapstick comedy focusing on the most popular characters from Despicable Me.

metas.name: Ice Age
metas.description: A classic buddy comedy set in the prehistoric era with the same adventure spirit as Migration.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: High-energy animal comedy that kids who liked Rio and Kung Fu Panda will love.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An adventure about a dog who thinks he has superpowers, fitting the action-comedy style of Sonic.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A wholesome and visually delightful movie that captures the classic charm of Alice in Wonderland.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A unique sci-fi and family story that shares the same emotional resonance as Turning Red.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: Extremely funny and creative, this is perfect for fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Set inside the world of video games, it will appeal to the same audience that enjoyed Mario and Sonic.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest movies with sharp comedy that fans of Shrek will enjoy.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: A brave and heroic journey that fans of Raya and the Last Dragon and Moana will appreciate.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: A magical musical classic that fits perfectly with Frozen and Tangled.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A classic Pixar story about friendship and sportsmanship that is great for young fans of Toy Story.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A charming and funny movie about a class lizard that offers wisdom and humor similar to Sing.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: Disney's newest musical adventure about making wishes come true, similar to Encanto and Frozen.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A creative story about overcoming fears that matches the imaginative world of Inside Out.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: A fun spin-off from the Shrek world that captures the adventure seen in Puss in Boots: The Last Wish.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: The original masterpiece that sets the stage for the sequels and prequels the kids have already seen.

metas.name: Shrek Forever After
metas.description: Continues the story of Shrek and Fiona with the same humor and heart as the first two films.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning world where fire and water meet, dealing with family and emotions like Turning Red.

metas.name: Strange World
metas.description: A grand pulp-fiction style adventure that fans of Castle in the Sky and The Sea Beast will enjoy.

metas.name: Ferdinand
metas.description: A sweet and funny movie about a gentle bull that fits the animal-adventure theme of Migration and Rio.
